newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's two-yr note yield seen at 6.09 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's two-yr note yield seen at 6.09 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $18.25 billion in two-year notes on Wednesday is expected to produce a yield near 6.09 percent, dealers said.

"We think there's some pretty good demand for it," said Tom O'Connell, a short coupon trader at First Chicago Capital Markets Inc. "I'm thinking 6.09 percent. It could get as weak as 6.10 but there seems to be a solid bid for these (notes)."
At 1240 EDT/1640 GMT, the two-year notes were quoted at 6.0875 percent in when-issued trade. The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
